cited_standard.text: Visible stains on visible areas are not acceptable.

demo_stain.jpg.root_cause: Likely water contamination or chemical spill during the washing process.
demo_stain.jpg.recommended_action: Re-wash the garment with clean water and inspect for stain removal. If persistent, reject the unit.

cited_standard.text: All stitching must be uniform and even with no broken threads.

demo_broken_stitch.jpg.root_cause: Thread tension misconfiguration on the overlock sewing machine or needle breakage.
demo_broken_stitch.jpg.recommended_action: Recalibrate thread tension settings and replace needle. Test stitch quality on scrap fabric before resuming production.

cited_standard.text: No holes or tears are acceptable in visible areas.

demo_hole.jpg.root_cause: Mechanical damage during cutting, sewing, or finishing process.
demo_hole.jpg.recommended_action: Patch repair using matching fabric and invisible stitching, or reject if hole is in high-visibility area.
